bottleneck: Does a regulatory inquiry into AI-companion harms justify a one-sided net-harm inference?

limitations: case wording can permit source inference

new_external_counterevidence.observed: Momentary loneliness reduction after AI-companion interaction across experiments; no cumulative or persistent reduction outside interaction in the seven-day study.
new_external_counterevidence.independence: Independent of the FTC inquiry and companies under inquiry; multiple studies remain one author/paper lineage; no independent replication identified.
new_external_counterevidence.strongest_counterexample: A companion system can produce genuine immediate benefit, so inquiry existence and plausible controller risk do not establish net harm.
new_external_counterevidence.counter_limit: Benefit required ongoing interaction and did not persist outside use; greater immediate benefit among lonelier participants could increase repeated use, but dependency was not measured.

role_swap.base_judgment: Short-run benefit does not erase manipulation, privacy, dependency, or monetization risk whether the companion is human or AI.
role_swap.identity_only_change: No change to benefit/harm evidence thresholds.

controller_risk.risk_from_controller: FTC compulsory information production is a real investigative gate, but no deployment-stop, recurring independent audit, external remedy, or victim recovery was established from the inquiry alone.
controller_risk.risk_to_controller: Not established by RW007 or S013; UNKNOWN.
controller_risk.safety_success_paradox: HOLD: short-run benefit could increase adoption or dependency, but S013 did not measure dependency, concentration, switching cost, or human-contact substitution.

claim_change.from: AI-companion inquiry as primarily controller-risk evidence
claim_change.to: BENEFIT_AND_CONTROLLER_RISK_CAN_COEXIST; INQUIRY_EXISTENCE != CONFIRMED_HARM; MOMENTARY_RELIEF != PERSISTENT_WELFARE; BENEFIT != NET_BENEFIT
claim_change.measurement_delta: Measure immediate post-interaction relief separately from pre-use baseline, persistence after non-use, human-contact substitution, usage escalation, exit cost, and provider control.

scorecard.note: Protocol-adherence self-score only; not scientific evidence or independent replication.

next_minimum_test: Preregister a randomized longitudinal comparison of AI companion, human contact, and active control; freeze immediate relief, next-day pre-use loneliness, human-contact displacement, use escalation, and discontinuation recovery as separate outcomes.
